note: Physical stack of the IntM4TM2 interposer, in um, z = 0 at the substrate top. The interposer body is substrate.thickness_um + beol.attachment_surface_z_um; consumers derive it and no file stores it. Every copy of these values in this PDK is checked against this file by libs.tech/klayout/intm4tm2_tests/test_body_thickness.py.

citation.title: Experimental Investigation of Local Backside Etching Patterns for Passive Thermal Management in TSV-Free RF Silicon Interposers

beol.attachment_surface_note: Top of TopMetal2 in the reduced back-end, the mount plane; equal to the zmax_um of the top metal below.
beol.metals_note: Routing metals from the bottom up. The oxide between two metals spans the upper metal's zmin_um down to the lower one's zmax_um; the base oxide spans the substrate top up to the first metal's zmin_um.
beol.passivation_note: Dielectric films over the attach plane, from the bottom up: the first starts at attachment_surface_z_um and each next one on the one below. They lie above the plane, so they are not part of the body; pads are opened through them (Passiv).
beol.passivation_source: the public IHP SG13G2 process specification, ihp-sg13g2/libs.doc/doc/SG13G2_os_process_spec.pdf (Rev. 1.2): TPASS1, 1500 nm oxide, and TPASS2, 400 nm SiN (p. 17), with epsilon_r 6.6 in the SiN (p. 5). The oxide takes the BEOL oxide's 4.1, as the public SG13G2 EM stack does (ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/openems/openems_ihp_sg13g2/workflow/SG13G2_200um.xml, SiO2 up to 1.5 um over the top of TopMetal2, then Passive 0.4 um).
